requirement: A WO demo's blog shows the restaurant's own posts, written by the build without a model; leftover demo posts unpublished only after the writes read back

oracle.ref: PR #1470 (feat); fix evidence: PR 1470; before it the agent pasted the items at hand-off (E2E wobrief 19/10/2026: Our History kept demo text, a run died on MALFORMED_RESPONSE)
oracle.invariant: S1: the first N demo posts in page order get the items' titles and bodies in the CMS's own shape (escaped), slug/alias kept, published; the rest of that page's demo posts are unpublished; receipts and the old words are recorded. S2: a read-back mismatch unpublishes nothing; a retry skips posts already written (EmDash rewrites one the model overwrote). S3: nothing is read or written.
